notes.title: Update 2.0 - Drop Discount
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for giving us your feedback on various aspects of the game. With this feedback in mind we have made a variety of changes that should help new players, and make returning players have a more smooth experience.

[list]
[*] Added various hints to the main menu to help new players understand what to do a bit better.
[*] Fixed various bugs and a crash from getting out of bounds.
[*] Made it possible to return to menu during a run (You no longer have to win/lose to return to Menu)
[*] Added a Quit button to the main menu.
[*] Load time and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Made Curved pipes more curvy
[*] Fixed some water visuals
[*] Improved opening narration (You can hit the radio to turn it off)
[*] Fixed object destruction not working at times. (Certain crates and bottles on the bar should now break as intended!)
[*] Fixed Voices toggle
[/list]

Thanks again for playing the game, and thank you everyone who has provided feedback on the initial version!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Levels are now marked as complete upon win, instead of when loading into the next level.
[*] First Wrench is now in your back Belt socket instead of on the ground
[*] Fixed U shape pipe bug
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed possible problem with level 2 causing some users to get stuck.
[*] Updated U shape pipe to be more curved.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.content:
Fixed a variety of issues related to the first few levels of Training, as well as the menu.

[list]
[*] Fixed lose condition when disconnecting pipes from starting/ending pipe.
[*] Fixed Training lines talking over each other.
[*] Fixed several bugs in the first couple story levels causing them to be unbeatable in cases.
[*] Added wrench to all Training Levels.
[*] Made items on Menu grabbable.
[*] Various small improvements/fixes to Menu.
[*] Fixed overlapping music with win music.
[*] Fixed Sound settings not effecting various Menu clicking sounds.
[/list]

Hopefully these fixes will result in a much better experience for all players.
Thank you for playing the game!
